shortDescription: Dungeons from Alexander Wales' "This Used to Be About Dungeons": levelled sites across the world map that generate a fresh themed pocket map per party, stocked with Titan Framework creatures and Entad Framework rewards.
body:
## Status
Build order: 1 World (placement, level map, settings, map toggle) → 2 Entry (gizmo, right-click, party dialog, pocket map, exit, once-per-pawn) → 3 Map generation (themes, chambers, dividers) → 4 Creatures → 5 Rewards → 6 Vehicle Framework (ocean dungeons).
Phase 1 in progress.

## World (phase 1)
- Dungeons are lightweight data on a WorldComponent (tile + level), not WorldObjects: thousands of them would slow the world map. Drawn by a custom world draw layer; a real site object is made only when a caravan needs one (phase 2).
- Placement: Poisson-disk spacing on the surface layer, minimum distance = setting (default 3 tiles). Land only, skips impassable tiles and tiles with a settlement or other world object. Water tiles allowed when Vehicle Framework is active (phase 6).
- Levels: 3D Perlin noise over the globe gives smooth valleys and peaks. Values are ranked into percentiles so every level gets dungeons, then skewed toward low levels by an exponent, mapped onto 1..max level.
- Generated on new worlds and the first time an older save loads. Settings changes affect only worlds generated after them (dev action regenerates).
- World map toggle (bottom right play settings) shows/hides icons; icon opacity in settings.

## Agreed design (later phases)
- Each party entering gets a freshly generated dungeon; level never changes. Leave by walking back to the entrance at any time; exit screen like Anomaly's pit gate, listing items on the map, pawns carry chosen items out. No boss, no time limit. If every party member dies, the instance is gone and the party is lost; downed doesn't count.
- Party: up to 5 humanlikes (animals and mechs free). A pawn may enter a given dungeon once; a party containing such a pawn can't enter.
- Effective level = level × wealth modifier (pawns + their gear only; ratio in settings). Points from effective level are linear for now.
- Creatures: humanlikes (xenotypes), animals, insects, mechs if feasible. Total points from effective level, variable count, packs. Dungeon Madness (scaria without rot) near-guaranteed; a pack where 2+ roll without madness is entirely free of it. Creatures without madness can be tamed. Undiscovered rooms keep creatures suspended.
- Rewards: entads via EntadApi, points from effective level, scattered; binding single / whole party / unbound by settings chances.
- Settings page uses tabs (World, Creatures, Rewards, Parties), reset button bottom right.
- Hard deps: Entad Framework, Titan Framework, Harmony. Vehicle Framework optional at runtime.
